---
title: "Topics"
subtitle: "The topic vocabulary behind the catalog."
description: "The 38 canonical topics of the Resources Catalog, with live entry counts, plus type and language facets."
search: true
---

The catalog's `category` field is being consolidated into a controlled vocabulary of **38 canonical topics**, defined in [`scripts/tags.toml`](https://github.com/antoinelucasfra/resources-catalog/blob/main/scripts/tags.toml). Every existing category value maps onto one of these topics, and entries matching no topic fall back to **General**. To propose a new topic, edit `scripts/tags.toml` and open a pull request — the tags and this page update at the next render. Counts below are computed live from `resources.txt`; badges are informational only (use the filters on the [home page](index.qmd) to drill down). Entries may carry several categories, so they can appear under several topics, and facet counts do not sum to the catalog size.

```{r topics}
#| execute: true
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis
source(here::here("resources.R"))
resources <- parse_resources_md(here::here("resources.txt"))

esc <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
}

# Canonical topics: parse the [topics] section of scripts/tags.toml
# ("Topic" = ["alias1", "alias2", ...]) and build alias -> topic lookup.
toml_lines <- readLines(here::here("scripts", "tags.toml"), encoding = "UTF-8")
sec_starts <- grep("^\\s*\\[", toml_lines)
topics_start <- grep("^\\s*\\[topics\\]", toml_lines)
topics_end <- min(sec_starts[sec_starts > topics_start]) - 1L
topic_block <- toml_lines[(topics_start + 1L):topics_end]

topic_of <- character()
for (line in topic_block) {
  if (!grepl('^\\s*"', line)) next
  quoted <- regmatches(line, gregexpr('"[^"]*"', line))[[1]]
  topic <- sub('^"(.*)"$', "\\1", quoted[1])
  for (alias in quoted) topic_of[sub('^"(.*)"$', "\\1", alias)] <- topic
}

# Topic counts: every matched category value votes its topic per entry;
# entries matching no topic fall back to General.
entry_topics <- lapply(resources$category, function(cat) {
  topics <- unique(topic_of[split_values(cat)])
  topics[!is.na(topics) & nzchar(topics)]
})
entry_topics[lengths(entry_topics) == 0] <- "General"

# Facet counts (categories, split like write_listing_items does)
topic_counts <- table(unlist(entry_topics))
type_counts <- table(esc(resources$type[nzchar(resources$type)]))
lang_values <- unlist(lapply(resources$language, split_values))
lang_counts <- table(esc(lang_values))

badges <- function(counts) {
  counts <- sort(counts, decreasing = TRUE)
  cat(paste0(
    '<span class="badge text-bg-secondary mx-1 my-1" style="font-size: 0.95rem;">',
    names(counts), " · ", counts, "</span>"
  ), sep = "\n")
}

cat("## Topics\n\n")
badges(topic_counts)
cat("\n\n## Types\n\n")
badges(type_counts)
cat("\n\n## Languages\n\n")
badges(lang_counts)
```
